HomeHeader.description: Let's be real: <bold>AI is already writing the code you're trying to learn.</bold> While you're dreaming of a six-figure salary, the market is preparing you for <bold>minimum wage entry roles</bold>. We skip the fluff. From the drudgery of <bold>QA Fundamentals</bold> to the brutal truth of the <bold>IT market</bold>, this is a survival guide for the <italic>Post-Junior era</italic>.<block>Build what machines cannot imagine, or get replaced by a prompt.</block>
